gaps: Lynn Haven's pay plan (class codes such as PD10 and FD01 appear in the budget, but the grade/range table was not found online). Request the current classification and pay plan with min/max by class code.
City Manager employment agreement (Chris Lightfoot, appointed March 16, 2026) and salary. Request the executed contract.

Police chief, fire chief, deputy/assistant chiefs and directors' salaries are not itemized, except where a director is the only position in a department. Request the FY2027 budgeted salary by position.

Fire union: firefighters formed a union in Oct 2024 and petitioned for a bargaining unit, and the city hired Jackson Lewis. No ratified CBA or step table was found. Request any CBA or PERC certification and the current firefighter pay scale.
Per-member pay for mayor and commissioners is not itemized. Request the ordinance or resolution setting commission compensation.
Actual payroll (unnamed) by position is not online. Request a payroll register extract.
notes: FY2027 (approved Sept 22, 2026): total FTE falls from 221.197 to 190.4 (General Fund 142.1; CRA 0.8; enterprise 47.5). No COLA for employees or commissioners, and city-wide payroll expenses are $1.69M lower than FY2026. The police budget drops $1.02M, mostly from staff reductions recommended by the Police Chief.
FY2026 (approved Sept 23, 2025) included a 3% COLA and 219.5 FTE.
